WASTEBIN_BASE_URL.description: Full public base URL used for paste links shown in the UI (https://your-domain). Auto-filled from the public domain.

WASTEBIN_TITLE.description: Site title shown in the browser tab and headers.

WASTEBIN_THEME.description: Default UI theme. One of: ayu, base16ocean, catppuccin, coldark, gruvbox, monokai, onehalf, rosepine, solarized.

WASTEBIN_MAX_BODY_SIZE.description: Maximum paste size in bytes (default 1 MiB). Raise for long logs, e.g. 5242880 for 5 MiB.

WASTEBIN_PASTE_EXPIRATIONS.description: Expiry options offered in the UI, comma-separated. '0' means no-expiry; durations: 10m, 1h, 1d, 1M, 1y.

WASTEBIN_SIGNING_KEY.description: Key for signing delete/owner tokens (must be >= 64 bytes — the server refuses to start otherwise). Auto-generated on first deploy; do not change on existing installs or owner tokens stop working.

WASTEBIN_PASSWORD_SALT.description: Random salt used for encrypting password-protected pastes (argon2). Auto-generated on first deploy.
